why: G2_FPS_MEFHC_P12.npz is the only g2-fullevent-v1 input in existence, it sat on purgeable scratch, and it had no CFS or off-cluster backup. Every downstream step (Gate-2 re-issue, P5A closure, P5A nominal) fail-closes without it because build_fullevent_loaders rejects any input that is not this schema.

source_survived_maintenance.note: Verified AFTER the 2026-07-22 -> 2026-08-03 maintenance window. The recorded hash matched, so the scratch copy was not damaged or partially purged; the runbook's reproduce-from-source contingency was not needed.

destination.note: The destination directory did not exist before this step, confirming there was genuinely no backup.

files.note: producer receipt copied alongside the dump; it records how to reproduce it

method.copy: cp -p (mode and mtime preserved; destination mtime reads Jul 19 03:10 as at source)
method.verification: sha256sum computed independently at source and at destination, both compared to the recorded value
method.fail_closed: the script refused to copy at all if the source hash did not match, and exits nonzero if the destination hash does not

scope.description: Data durability only. No science was computed, no gate was issued or re-issued, and no receipt hash binding moved.
